post.text: Video footage purported to show an Iranian ballistic missile strike on Prince Sultan Air Base in Al-Kharj, Saudi Arabia, with the missile impacting very close to several U.S. servicemembers, thankfully said to have resulted in only minor injuries to personnel at Prince Sultan. https://t.co/Nlju8TCZ22

description.description: A series of three low-light frames. In the first frame, a faint, glowing object is visible against a dark, cloudy night sky. The second frame shows the same sky, but the object shines more brightly and intensely. The third frame moves to an indoor setting, showing a blurry, close-up view of an orange-tinted door or wall.
